name: adversary_drafts
title: Adversary drafts: threats, projects, the Militarist
intro: One row per drafted card (134), grouped by deck: tier-1 and tier-2 threats, the project deck, the Militarist board, the Militarist event deck. Each tile shows the card's full text, its value line and its check. Toggle on what goes forward; nothing is preselected. Numbers are sane starting values, not tuned. Notes per row are welcome.
